title: Export with a tag-only search term includes the part found by its tag
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Setup: in the part dialog of the untracked part QAPL-U2 add the tag qapltagexp (a term that appears in no part number or description) and save. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Open /parts/inventory on the Active tab and type qapltagexp in the search; wait for the list.
  2. Open the ⋮ actions menu and pick Export (menu_item_inventory_export).
  3. Open the downloaded CSV.
  4. Click the Inactive tab (the search stays applied).
  5. Open the ⋮ actions menu and pick Export.
custom_expected:
1. Only QAPL-U2 is listed (found by its tag); its Total Qty reads Not Tracked.
  2. GET /api/inventory/parts/export is sent with status=active and the search term; a CSV file is downloaded.
  3. The CSV holds exactly one part row, QAPL-U2; its quantity cell reads Not Tracked; the file has no status column.
  4. The search is still applied and the list shows the shared filtered empty state ("No parts match…") with its clear-filters action.
  5. The "Empty export" message shows and no file is downloaded.
